resources.string: On Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Realme, Huawei, OnePlus, Samsung and similar phones you must allow this app to auto-start and run in the background. Otherwise the system stops it and SMS forwarding silently fails.
Couldn\'t find the Auto-start screen. Opened App info instead — enable Autostart / Allow background activity manually.
Runs a persistent background service with an ongoing notification so the system is much less likely to kill the app. Strongly recommended for reliable SMS forwarding.
